Testing the functional requirements, SIT (System Integration Testing, regression and User acceptance to verify client needs/ Business requirements are met. Completed in-depth analysis of business processes. Responsible for improve efficiencies and quality control to the Cash reconciliations process and supervising the team of 15 members. Responsible for maintaining and reviewing the reconciliations of funds – FX, Trade and Income using TLM and handling other products like private equity. Refines and develop the process standard operating procedures to ensure accuracy upon process updates. Running macros to settle the custody side Trades, FX and Income. Calling Custody monitor Macro. Reconciling the Custody balances with accounting balances using TLM Premium and Cash Summary Macro. Daily interaction with Onshore clients & Training team of 15 for running process operations Reporting aged breaks, high value breaks, disputed critical funds to the Management. NIIT Technologies PVT Ltd – Client- SEI Pvt ltd – Business Analyst – Special Activities group –  Trade Settlement, Private Equity
Bangalore, KA • 05/2015 - 11/2018 Cross-trained staff in various functions - Derivative processing, Common Trust funds processing, Margins & Securities lending. Handling the queries of Team members and onshore clients & Training team of 12 for running successful process operations & experience of developing procedures, service standards for business excellence. Preparing monthly dashboards and weekly volume reports & interacting with onshore supervising team on queries and updates of the Supervising team on queries and updates of the Special Activities Group processing. Preparing admissions & Withdrawal reports for Common Trust Funds from the data provided by Fund Accounting Team. Bank loan processing – Loan settlements, interest posting and Trade settlements. Cash Movements and shares position adjustments for Forwards, Futures & Margins & Clearing the TLM exceptions for the same business day. Bank Of America Continuum India Private Limited - Senior Process Associate- Collateral Management- Portfolio reconciliations
Hyderabad • 04/2011 - 09/2013 Reconciliation of Disputed Portfolios of both counterparty and Bank of America. Trade by trade comparison to resolve the dispute in the margin of the Collateral. Analyzing the Mark to Market differences of the collateral transactions and matching own trades with counterparty trades. Resolving and escalation of all client disputes and queries to the Global Collateral Management team. Daily interaction with the global Collateral Management team and Middle Office to confirm the Mark to Market values of trades in Dispute portfolios. FRANKLIN TEMPLETON INTERNATIONAL SERVICES PVT LTD - Process Analyst – Canada Transfer Agency
Hyderabad 05/2008 - 09/2010 Processing operations of Mutual fund Investments Services such as maintaining client data. Purchases that deal purchases on the share Holder's Existing/New accounts at various Level of Break Point for Reduction in sales charges. It also includes incoming transfer of funds etc Exchanges /Switches that deal with exchanging the fund for another within the same fund family.
